"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/valid-boomerang/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1037. Valid Boomerang

Given an array points where points[i] = [x_i, y_i] represents a point on the X-Y plane, return true if these points are a boomerang.

A boomerang is a set of three points that are all distinct and not in a straight line.

Example 1:

Input: points = [[1,1],[2,3],[3,2]]
Output: true

Example 2:

Input: points = [[1,1],[2,2],[3,3]]
Output: false

Constraints:

    points.length == 3
    points[i].length == 2
    0 <= x_i, y_i <= 100
"""


class Solution:
    def isBoomerang(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> bool:
        (x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3) = points
        # Check all points are distinct
        if (
            (x1 == x2 and y1 == y2)
            or (x1 == x3 and y1 == y3)
            or (x2 == x3 and y2 == y3)
        ):
            return False
        # Check if points are collinear by comparing slopes
        # To avoid division, use cross multiplication
        return (y2 - y1) * (x3 - x2) != (y3 - y2) * (x2 - x1)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.isBoomerang([[1, 1], [2, 3], [3, 2]]))  # True

assert sol.isBoomerang([[1, 1], [2, 3], [3, 2]]) == True
assert sol.isBoomerang([[1, 1], [2, 2], [3, 3]]) == False

assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]]) == True
assert sol.isBoomerang([[100, 100], [50, 50], [0, 0]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 2]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [1, 1], [1, 1]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [1, 2], [2, 4]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [2, 1], [4, 2]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [0, 100], [100, 0]]) == True
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [100, 100], [50, 50]]) == False
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [1, 2], [2, 3]]) == True
assert sol.isBoomerang([[0, 0], [0, 0], [1, 1]]) == False
